dimensions.label: 数据隐私 / Data privacy
dimensions.note: The social-infrastructure theme could drift into identity, relationship, or location profiling.
dimensions.mitigation: Match authorised tasks and resources only; prohibit biometric and relationship data; minimise and expire tokens; retain an account-free route.
dimensions.human_review: A data and ethics seat reviews purpose, fields, retention, access, model boundary, complaints, and deletion before each pilot.

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度 / Implementation complexity
dimensions.note: Cross-organisation space access, safety, and service protocols require coordination.
dimensions.mitigation: Begin with one ninety-day reversible pilot and a named operator; scale only after two stable cycles.
dimensions.human_review: Venue, fire, accessibility, transport, heritage, and operating leads approve their respective conditions.

dimensions.label: 公众接受度 / Public acceptance
dimensions.note: Residents may perceive an AI-talent programme as exclusive, noisy, or promotional.
dimensions.mitigation: Free public hours, community problem seats, quiet periods, legible stop rules, and public retrospectives are built into operations.
dimensions.human_review: Youth and community representatives can veto exclusionary formats and trigger reduction or retirement.

dimensions.label: 运维成本 / Operations cost
dimensions.note: Hosts, maintenance, multilingual service, and accessibility support create recurring costs.
dimensions.mitigation: Require an operator and maintenance plan before capital works; use movable, replaceable, offline-capable components.
dimensions.human_review: An independent operating and cost review is required before any permanent upgrade.

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性 / Policy uncertainty
dimensions.note: Official geometry, statutory controls, event approvals, and delivery responsibilities are not yet confirmed.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep affected metrics unknown or provisional and separate concept sequence from approved policy or investment.
dimensions.human_review: Relevant authorities and qualified teams confirm planning, approval, procurement, and policy applicability.

dimensions.label: 空间争议 / Spatial dispute
dimensions.note: Provisional polygons and unverified ownership could place a concept outside the intended or available site.
dimensions.mitigation: Use transferable node types, grey dashed provisional frames, and mandatory whole-package recomputation after official data.
dimensions.human_review: Survey, ownership, heritage, ecology, transport, and site operators jointly confirm any location.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度 / Technology maturity
dimensions.note: Model errors, mistranslation, outage, or unsafe testing could harm trust and access.
dimensions.mitigation: Rule-first filtering, linked sources, isolated tests, human release, physical stop, offline service, and replaceable interfaces.
dimensions.human_review: Independent safety and service review decides whether each bounded test stops, changes, or expands.

dimensions.label: 公平与包容 / Equity and inclusion
dimensions.note: Digital entry, professional language, or commercial programming could exclude residents, newcomers, and disabled visitors.
dimensions.mitigation: Provide walk-in and human equivalents, multilingual plain text, quiet and accessible participation, and no ranking by spending or funding.
dimensions.human_review: Access-first users and community representatives test every pilot and can require correction before continuation.
